fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with tests that (1) a topic naming a shared block prints its full text in place of the marker line, with no marker left in any listed text; (2) the expansion of a text naming an unknown block fails with an error naming the block (the load panics on it); (3) every listed text, expanded, stays within its cap; (4) the never-list block forbids sleeping or polling, stubs, TODOs and placeholders, new dependencies, rewriting history and chaining session done; and the budget, scoped-tests, unstable-CI, outside-work and done phrases build_test.go and budget_test.go check today are found in the shared files, each in exactly one file.
fields.statement: The guide keeps each shared block (session done rule, test scope, unstable CI, command budget, outside work, never-list) once as a markdown file under internal/guide/text/shared/, and a topic line `<!-- shared: <block> -->` is replaced by that block when the guide loads, so `rhiza guide <topic>`, the installed skills and the TopicCap all see the expanded text.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with a builder test that finds the six section headings in order, the shared done, test-scope, unstable-CI, command-budget, outside-work and never-list blocks expanded, the read-patterns-first and question-before-work rules, the acceptance commands, rhiza ship generate, rhiza render and the Checks: block above the one final trailer paragraph (the builder-prehandoff-checklist and guides-one-final-paragraph points, moved from build.md's tests), the actor-record git add line, and the RHIZA_ATTEMPT > 1 rule naming both /rhiza-build-retry and `rhiza guide build-retry`; a negative case asserts the builder text names no Go, make or repo-specific command.
fields.statement: `rhiza guide builder` gives a leaf's builder afk's builder prompt in Rhiza's words on six sections in order (Task, Expected outcome, Read first, Must do, Must not do, Context): the leaf's acceptance is the contract; read the slice, the leaf and the existing code and tests that follow the pattern before writing; raise a question the owner must answer before starting work, not midway; run the pre-handoff checklist and report a Checks: block; end with one commit carrying the trailers and the staged actor record, then session done as its own command; no stubs, TODOs, placeholders or new dependencies; and on attempt > 1 (RHIZA_ATTEMPT > 1) load build-retry first.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with a verifier test that finds the six section headings in order, the shared done, test-scope, command-budget and never-list blocks expanded, the detached checkout, Never edit code, fakes only, the re-run of the Checks: block and acceptance commands with a missing block or a different exit code a finding naming the command (the verifier-reruns-reported-checks points, moved from build.md's tests), the scope and no-stub points, the Evidence apply example and the rhiza run findings heredoc, and the rule that each finding names a file, command or acceptance point; a negative case asserts it carries no builder commit or trailer instructions.
fields.statement: `rhiza guide verifier` gives a leaf's verifier afk's verifier prompt in Rhiza's words on the same six sections: in a detached checkout at the leaf's commit it re-runs every command of the Checks: block and every acceptance command, reads the diff and confirms each acceptance point is met and tested, nothing outside the leaf changed and no stubs or TODOs were left; it never edits code and uses fakes only; it ends with Evidence written as itself or with findings, each naming the file, command or acceptance point and what to change so a fixer can act without re-diagnosing, then session done as its own command.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with a build-retry test that finds the inspect-the-working-tree rule, rhiza run status --json, address every finding as written, the same `Leaf:` trailer fix commit and never rewrite history, and asserts the text stays under a third of the TopicCap and repeats none of the builder topic's shared blocks.
fields.statement: `rhiza guide build-retry` tells a builder on a later attempt only what a retry adds: inspect the working tree and the earlier attempts' commits for their partial work, read the previous attempt's findings (in the prompt when there, else `rhiza run status --json`), address every finding exactly as written, and add one fix commit with the same Leaf: trailer, never rewriting history.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run GuideInstall passes with the three new skill files written with their topic's description and expanded body, and re-running install reports them unchanged; go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... asserts the build index names builder, verifier and build-retry and both their skill and `rhiza guide` routes; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(guide|guide-install)' passes with the new topics in guide ls and the new skill paths in the install output.
fields.statement: `rhiza guide ls` lists the builder, verifier and build-retry topics, guide install writes them as the rhiza-builder, rhiza-verifier and rhiza-build-retry skills beside the others, and the build topic (still installed as rhiza-build) is a short index that names the three role topics and says which one each role loads, so workflows that still say /rhiza-build or `rhiza guide build` keep working.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes with the builtin builder and verifier prompt tests updated to the one-line prompts (no checklist, Checks:, session done or test-scope text left in them) and a test that review.toml's verifier prompt equals build.toml's; a test reads .rhiza/workflows/docs-build.toml and asserts its verifier prompt equals the builtin one and its builder prompt starts with the builtin line and keeps the humanize addendum; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(build-evidence-commit|docs-commands-exist)' passes; the describe-golden script is regenerated only if its output changed; make self-check passes.
fields.statement: The builtin build workflow's builder prompt is the one line `/rhiza-builder Build leaf {leaf} of change set {change} ({title}), attempt {attempt}: follow rhiza guide builder.` and its verifier prompt, and review.toml's leaf verifier prompt, the one line `/rhiza-verifier Verify leaf {leaf} of change set {change} ({title}) at commit $RHIZA_COMMIT: follow rhiza guide verifier.`; Rhiza's .rhiza/workflows/docs-build.toml uses the builder line plus its unchanged doc-prose addendum and the verifier line byte for byte.

set.acceptance: `rhiza guide ls` lists the build, builder, verifier and build-retry topics; go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... finds the trailer, the outside-work rule and the Evidence-or-findings rule in the role topics and the three names in the build index; `rhiza guide install` writes all four as skills.
set.statement: `rhiza guide build` is the build index: it names the builder, verifier and build-retry topics and says which a builder, a verifier and a retrying builder load; the role topics carry where to start, the Leaf: trailer, needed outside work as a question and noticed-only work as a discovered-from draft change set never built in the run, and the verifier's Evidence or findings; guide install installs them all.
